commit 5ae4b2f9b9b34d109c9c4124383e9b5c2212bb45
Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
AuthorDate: Thu May 28 09:01:21 2026 -0600
Commit:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>
CommitDate: Thu May 28 09:01:21 2026 -0600

    Bug 760856 - Assume custom flag support for newly created IMAP folders to prevent tag stripping. r=mkmelin
    
    
    The Problem:
    When moving or copying a local folder containing tagged messages to an IMAP
    server, the client issues a CREATE command followed immediately by APPEND
    commands, intentionally bypassing a SELECT command to optimize network
    traffic.
    
    Because the newly created folder has never been selected, the local .msf
    database has not received a PERMANENTFLAGS response from the server.
    Consequently, it pessimistically defaults to assuming that custom user flags
    (tags) are not supported. When nsImapMailFolder::GetCurMoveCopyMessageInfo
    checks these capabilities during the upload pipeline, it strips all custom
    keywords from the messages before constructing the APPEND command.
    
    The Solution:
    Modify nsImapMailFolder::CreateClientSubfolderInfo to optimistically
    initialize newly created subfolders with kImapMsgSupportUserFlag,
    kImapMsgSupportForwardedFlag, and kImapMsgSupportMDNSentFlag.
    
    This ensures that the initial batch of APPEND commands will include the
    custom tags. Per RFC 3501, if a legacy server does not actually support
    these flags, it will safely ignore the unrecognized keywords and append the
    message anyway. The local database's indeterminate state will then
    automatically self-correct to the server's true capabilities the first time
    the folder is naturally SELECTed.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D302752

diff --git a/mailnews/imap/src/nsImapMailFolder.cpp b/mailnews/imap/src/nsImapMailFolder.cpp
index 4f354ff0354..a1e27aa0388 100644
--- a/mailnews/imap/src/nsImapMailFolder.cpp
+++ b/mailnews/imap/src/nsImapMailFolder.cpp
@@ -959,10 +959,19 @@ NS_IMETHODIMP nsImapMailFolder::CreateClientSubfolderInfo(
       rv = CopyFolderNameToUTF16(folderName, unicodeName);
       if (NS_SUCCEEDED(rv)) child->SetName(NS_ConvertUTF16toUTF8(unicodeName));
 
-      // store the online name as the mailbox name in the db folder info
-      // I don't think anyone uses the mailbox name, so we'll use it
-      // to restore the online name when blowing away an imap db.
-      if (folderInfo) folderInfo->SetMailboxName(onlineName);
+      if (folderInfo) {
+        // store the online name as the mailbox name in the db folder info
+        // I don't think anyone uses the mailbox name, so we'll use it
+        // to restore the online name when blowing away an imap db.
+        folderInfo->SetMailboxName(onlineName);
+        // Optimistically assume the server supports user flags, forwarded
+        // status, and MDN sent status until a future SELECT proves otherwise.
+        uint32_t imapFlags = 0;
+        folderInfo->GetUint32Property("imapFlags", 0, &imapFlags);
+        imapFlags |= kImapMsgSupportUserFlag | kImapMsgSupportForwardedFlag |
+                     kImapMsgSupportMDNSentFlag;
+        folderInfo->SetUint32Property("imapFlags", imapFlags);
+      }
     }
 
     unusedDB->SetSummaryValid(true);
title: Bug 760856 - Assume custom flag support for newly created IMAP folders to prevent tag stripping. r=mkmelin
